g.text: Input: fanout points share one horizontal line
Output: spread, descend in gaps, turn into vias

polyline.data-label: N1: gap 3, turn right (visual offset only)
N2: gap 4, turn right (visual offset only)
N3: gap 5, turn right (visual offset only)
N4: gap 6, turn right (visual offset only)
N5: gap 8, turn left (visual offset only)
N6: gap 9, turn left (visual offset only)
N1: gap 10, turn left (visual offset only)
N2: gap 11, turn left (visual offset only)
